Dometic is a global leader in outdoor living solutions, providing essential gear for an adventurous lifestyle. We are on an exciting growth and transformation journey – now seeking an Inside Sales Specialist for supporting our Hospitality business unit in Germany and the D\-A\-CH countries.
   

  

**About The Position**
 In this role, you will be responsible for different type of activities like sales support, order management as well as exploring new business opportunities.
   

  

**Your Main Responsibilities**
* New business hunter. Regularly and consistently look for new business both in Hospitality and Healthcare markets.
* Represent Dometic in discussions (via Video conference, Telephone calls, etc) with existing accounts, other customers and third parties (which includes Furniture Manufacturers, Architects, purchasing groups, construction companies, System integrators, etc. to name a few) in a professional, ethical and efficient manner to create trust, long term relationships and a successful business both in Hospitality and Healthcare markets.
* Execution of the defined sales strategy by Direct Sales Manager.
* Implementation of the strategy: prospection, quotation process, pipeline follow up, closing deals, etc...
* Collaborate with the current and future Distribution Channel, optimising time spent and other resources.
* Support Management in the budget process, in follow up and forecasting, in monthly reports and as otherwise required, in a timely manner.


**Order satisfaction:**
* Support and manage all hospitality customers across the DACH region, with a strong focus on B2B clients such as dealers, furniture manufacturers, and purchasing companies
* To handle orders by telephone, email and check that the orders have the correct prices, discounts and product numbers, and contact customers to resolve any queries.
* To ensure that orders are processed in line with customers’ delivery requirements. Inform the customers of any delays and will arrange alternative delivery dates.
* Prepare shipping and export documePrepare shippinntation


**Coordination:**
* Collaborating with other cross functional departments is an important responsibility (Supply Chain/ Product Management/ Accounting etc..).
* To follow up closely with the finance team all account receivables related to DACHH sales transactions.
* Handle returns management, including preparation of return documents and credit notes


**Sales support:**
* HOSP CRM is to be updated and always developed and continuously for both segments: Hotels and Healthcare.
* Maintain and update customer master data within the ERP system (Trend System)
* Ensure that the sales reps have enough sales support material, such as product brochures or case studies.
* First point of contact for urgent calls, emails.
* Process and coordinate customer complaints, damage claims, and service cases in collaboration with Customer Service
* To follow up customer invoicing daily.
* Maintain product and pricing data within customer systems
* Handle reporting and data maintenance within customer databases


**Reporting:**
* To maintain sales records, as a basis for reports to the senior management team.
* HOSP CRM continuous update is a must.
* To prepare reports on sales by individual representatives, sales by product line and sales to individual customers.
* To provide information to the Demand Planning Team department on incoming and completed orders, as a basis for forecasting cash flow.
* Reporting lines may change if required.


**What do we offer?**
 You are offered an exciting opportunity in a dynamic, fast‑paced, and global environment, where you will play a key role in supporting and developing the business. In this role, your ideas matter, your impact is visible, and you will collaborate closely with stakeholders across the organization. Join a company on an ambitious transformation journey, with great opportunities to grow and take on new challenges.
   

  

*Dometic is passionate about building together an inclusive and equitable working environment, that respects individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that diversity enables us to thrive across our differences. Be yourself and join us!*
 ,
   

  

**Skills \& Requirements**
 A suitable background would be the following in terms of qualification and experience:
   

  

* Ability to work in and report to a multicultural remote Management environment.
* Around 3 years’ experience in a similar role.
* A similar position in the industry; knowledge of the hotel/care market is advantageous.
* Good knowledge of all Microsoft Office products.
* Knowledge of English and German is a must (additional language is a plus).
* An open manner of interacting with people, strong in sales negotiations
* Premium brand and high valued USP’s.
* Customers and results oriented.


**To be successful in this role, we believe that you possess the following skills, competencies \& characteristics:**
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Learn and adapt.
* Engage and inspire.
* Sales negotiations.
* Focused on profitable sales growth.
* Result and action orientated.


**Dometic's Core Values**
 To thrive and succeed in this role, you understand the importance of our core values – Together We build our future, We play to win, We embrace change and We walk the talk; these values reflect the heart and soul of Dometic and they define what it takes to work here and how we do things.
   

  

 Dometic operates with a 4\+1 policy, 4 days per week in the office and the possibility to work 1 day per week remotely. We see the social aspect of being in the office, meeting colleagues, having short coffee break interactions or a quick face to face meeting as key to success as we become more productive and fast paced in terms of problem solving, learning, cross functional collaboration and not the least in a way to have fun at work!
   

  

**Are you our next star?** 
 Then we would love to see your application. Selection is being made on a rolling basis.

**Description**
 Als Nachwuchsführungskraft wirst du in unserem 11\-wöchigen internen Onboarding Programm auf deine neue Aufgabe als Führungskraft vorbereitet.
   

  

 Nach dieser umfangreichen Einarbeitung übernimmst du Führungsverantwortung für dein eigenes Team und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden Ihre Waren pünktlich und in guter Qualität erhalten. In dieser Position bist du wichtiger Teil unseres globalen Unternehmens und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit deinen Mitarbeitenden vor Ort. Zudem arbeitest du standortübergreifend an Themen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Nachhaltigkeit und technischem Fortschritt.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften und des Umweltschutzes
* Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und konkreten Maßnahmen zur Prozessverbesserung auf Basis von Kennzahlen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Produktivität und Qualität
* Leitung und Weiterbildung eines Teams (bis zu 100 Mitarbeitende)
* Planung und Steuerung der innerbetrieblichen Prozesse
* Teilnahme in übergeordneten Projekten zur Optimierung der Kundenzufriedenheit
* Effektives Ressourcen\- und Workflowmanagement
* Zusammenarbeit mit den vor\- und nachgelagerten Abteilungen vor Ort


 A day in the life
   

  

 Du arbeitest in einer unserer Schichten (Früh\-, Spät\- oder Nachtschicht). Dabei ist das Einhalten der Sicherheitsstandards an deinem gesamten Standort für dich höchste Priorität. Als Schichtleitung führst du routinemäßig Teammeetings durch und führst Feedbackgespräche mit deinen Mitarbeitenden und deinen Stakeholdern. Mit Hilfe von Datenauswertungen nimmst Du Einfluss auf die Produktivität und die Qualität deines Standortes. Als wichtiges Mitglied des Teams vor Ort arbeitest Du mit anderen Abteilungen, sowie externen Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kundschaft, ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Durch die Analyse von Daten mit Führungskräften und die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor\- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit den Fachabteilungen trägst du zu „best in class“ Lösungen bei.

At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
   

  

 Could you be the full\-time
 **Project Planning Manager(f/m/d)** 
 in Siegen we’re looking for?
   

  

**Your Future Role**
 Our Siegen site is an international competence center for bogies. 800 colleagues develop, manufacture, test, and repair bogies for global rail traffic, ensuring stability and comfort on the tracks. Our product line Rolling Stock \& Components offers products from the broadest portfolio in the rail industry. Our innovation focus is on green and smart solutions, including emission\-free propulsion systems such as batteries and hydrogen.
   

  

 You’ll report to
 **Ildiko ZORGEL** 
 and work alongside a dedicated and enthusiastic team.
   

  

 As
 **Project Planning Manager** 
 , you are the planning partner within our Bogies Project Management Team.
   

  

 For
 **Bogies development** 
 projects you are the close partner of our Project Managers. You will:
   

  

* Build and control project schedules across international teams
* Track progress, risks and critical paths to ensure on\-time development and \-delivery
* Support Earned Value Management and project reporting
* Lead planning reviews and drive continuous improvement


 For
 **Bogies tender projects** 
 you are the close partner of our Project Group Managers. You will:
   

  

* Harmonize tender\- and bid project schedules along our Gate Review Process
* Lead tender input calculation processing for our Bogie PM roles


 For
 **PM capacity\- \& load planning** 
 you are the close partner of our Projects Director. You will:
   

  

* Maintain the PM resource planning
* Support the Projects Director for headcount planning and staffing decisions


 Within a team of 2\-3 further international Bogie Project Planning partners of our PM Team Siegen your work creates transparency, reliability and successful project delivery.
   

  

**All About You**
 We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
   

  

* Degree in engineering, business administration or comparable experience
* Experience in project planning, scheduling or project management
* Confident working with planning tools and structured processes
* Strong communicator with a collaborative, international mindset
* Fluent in German and English (French is a plus).


**Things You’ll Enjoy**
 Join us on a life\-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
   

  

* Experience a dynamic work environment with a permanent position at a leading company for green mobility
* Enjoy a competitive remuneration package (IG Metall), 30 days of vacation, and benefits such as company pension plans and subsidized “Deutschlandticket” (Job Ticket)
* Optimise work\-life balance with flexible working hours and hybrid working models
* Explore growth opportunities and steer your career across functions and countries
* Benefit from excellent training opportunities through our award\-winning Alstom University and participate in the company's innovation culture through idea management programmes
* Thrive in a modern and collaborative workplace featuring mentor and buddy programs, diversity \& inclusion initiatives, CSR activities, and engaging employee events
* Enjoy a comprehensive corporate health management with various initiatives such as physiotherapy, massages, flu vaccinations, blood donation drives, etc.
* Access corporate benefits and work\-life service to receive support and guidance on childcare, caregiving, and household services.


 You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!
   

  

**Equal Opportunities Statement**
 As an employer, Alstom stands for equal opportunities. By creating an inclusive work environment where all employees are encouraged to realise their full potential, individual differences are valued and respected. All applicants are considered solely on the basis of their qualifications, regardless of skin colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, ethnic and national origin, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Als junges E\-Commerce Startup aus dem Sauerland suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Customer Support Manager für Amazon/Shop/Otto (m/w/d).
 


  

 Aufgaben
   


 In Deiner Hand liegt die eigenverantwortliche Planung, Koordination und Erfolgsbewertung des gesamten Customer Supports über unsere Kanäle Amazon, Otto und Mail.
 


  

  
* Entwicklung und Umsetzung neuer Support\-Strategien – von Antwort\-Workflows über Eskalationsprozesse bis hin zu Self\-Service\-Inhalten und Antwort\-Templates
  
* Du fungierst als wichtige Schnittstelle und bist im regelmäßigen Austausch mit den Online\-Kanälen, Vertrieb und dem Content Team
  
* Monitoring der Konkurrenz – wie reagieren andere Marken auf Kundenanfragen, Reviews und Beschwerden, und was können wir daraus lernen
  
* Laufende Optimierung unserer kundenrelevanten Inhalte (FAQs, Produktbeschreibungen, Mailvorlagen) in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Content\-Team, um Anfragen proaktiv zu reduzieren und die Servicequalität zu steigern
  
* Du führst eigenständig Service\-Audits durch – Antwortzeiten, Tonalität, Lösungsqualität und Kundenzufriedenheit über alle drei Kanäle hinweg
  
* Du übernimmst Trend\- und Potenzialanalysen auf Basis von Kundenfeedback, Reviews und Ticketdaten und leitest daraus konkrete Verbesserungen für Produkt, Content und Prozesse ab
  
* Du unterstützt beim Monitoring und Reporting der relevanten Support\-KPIs (Reaktions\- und Lösungszeiten, CSAT, Review\-Ratings, Wiederholungsquote)
  


  

 Qualifikation
   


**Das bringst Du mit** 



  


 Erste Erfahrung im Support, am besten in einem jungen Unternehmen mit ähnlicher Motivation. Wir sind keine Workaholics, aber erwarten Begeisterung für das Unternehmen.
 


  

  
* Hohe Eigenmotivation \& Selbstverantwortung
  
* Leidenschaft für strukturiertes Arbeiten und Projektmanagement – Du behältst auch bei vielen offenen Tickets über mehrere Kanäle hinweg den Überblick

* Offenheit und Kommunikationsfähigkeit, um Kund:innen zu begeistern, Beschwerden souverän zu drehen und schnell tragfähige Beziehungen zu knüpfen
  
* Tiefgehendes Verständnis für den Kanal Amazon (A\-bis\-Z\-Garantie, Käuferschutz, Reviews, Voice of the Customer) – idealerweise auch erste Berührungspunkte mit Otto
  
* Du begeisterst Dich für neue Technologien und aktuelle Trends im E\-Commerce, insbesondere im Bereich Service\-Automatisierung, KI\-gestützte Antworten und Self\-Service
  
* Du verfügst über eine gute schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeit und kannst auch komplexere Sachverhalte verständlich, freundlich und markengerecht gegenüber Kund:innen und Kolleg:innen wiedergeben
  
* Du bist kreativ und bringst gerne eigene Ideen mit ein – z. B. wie wir wiederkehrende Anfragen smarter lösen oder unsere Antwort\-Templates verbessern
  


  

 Benefits
   

  
* Remote oder im Office in Olpe
  
* 100% flexible Arbeitszeiten
  
* Sehr junges \& dynamisches Team
  
* Attraktive Boni bei Erreichen von Meilensteinen

**Tiered Approach**

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:


* **Tier 0** : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026\.
* **Tier 1** : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments
* **Tier 2** : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
* **Tier 3 or no tier indicated** : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.


**BACKGROUND**

UNDP works in about 170 countries and territories, helping to achieve the eradication of poverty, and the reduction of inequalities and exclusion. We help countries to develop policies, leadership skills, partnering abilities, institutional capabilities and build resilience in order to sustain development results. The Bureau for Management Services (BMS) is based in UNDP Headquarters, New York, and with outposted locations across multiple country locations, regional hubs, and global shared service centers.


BMS wants to put forth a long\-term vision to create a world in which digital and social media platforms serve as an empowering force for UNDP’s stakeholders. This vision describes how BMS can support UNDP’s digital presence by amplifying development through embedding digital platform across BMS programmes and projects.


**DUTIES AND RESPONSABILITIES**

Under the direct supervision and guidance of the Chief, Client Services Division, the Media Communication Specialist supports BMS in its day\-to\-day role as the corporate custodian of information and will specifically focus on providing advise related to internal and external communication to showcase UNDP’s operational blueprint, help with further development of microsite for the Operational Blue print and develop a regular newsletter to promote BMS work and advancement of initiatives. The incumbent will support BMS in nurturing strategic relationships and alliances essential to achieving the bureau’s mission as well as support the update and enhancement of the UNDP BMS intranet and internet presence to effectively showcase who we are and what we do.


Key responsibilities include:


**Design and implement the BMS Communication Strategy** :


* Draft a communication strategy for approval.
* Provide advise on internal and external communication to showcase UNDP operational blueprint.
* Promote the further development of microsite for the Operational Blue print.
* Develop a regular newsletter to promote BMS work and advancement of initiatives.
* Build strong relationships inside BMS and with partners to ensure appropriate product oversight and organizational buy in required for the product vision to be realized.
* Support the creation of social media accounts for new products and services to ensure coherence and deliverability.
* Provides strategic input in the conceptualization and implementation of BMS strategy for advocacy and positioning of UNDP, including coordinating and generating partnerships and collaboration and support for branding and marketing campaigns with multiple target audiences.

**Lead multi\-channel thought leadership campaigns and media:**

* Promote BMS work, vision and perspectives globally and in the regions with special attention on results and impact through media outreach, using new types of media and communication tools as appropriate;
* Act as the lead communications focal point on operational visits and engagements by the Bureau Director, including drafting communications plans, overseeing communications preparations, to include editing, fact checking and quality control.
* Preparing high quality talking points, speeches, press statements, and other written materials.
* Promote, advocate and raise awareness around BMS activities, results, flagship initiatives through a variety of communication vehicles.
* Enhance understanding and knowledge of UNDP stakeholders on development issues through substantive training sessions using BMS reports and data.

**Marketing BMS globally:**

* Implement and manage the strategic growth of BMS global audiences through all social media platforms.
* Develop, implement and evaluate social media plans for major communication projects and campaigns;
* Produce unique, compelling and engaging social content for use on BMS’s social networks with the aim to build and engage its online communities.
* Seek opportunities and partnerships to promote BMS and its priorities through social media; including development of partnerships with influencers who share UNDP’s values and drive paid advertising campaigns across social media.
* Optimises BMS’s social media ecosystem by gathering and analyzing digital intelligence to drive insights and suggestions for its social media and digital platforms.
* Produces regular reports, analysis on social media activities and traffic to provide insights and recommendations;

**Facilitate capacity\-building, knowledge\-sharing and quality control in:**

* Work closely with other BMS Units to support their agreed strategic communications objectives, offering mentoring and advice when needed.
* Provide guidance, coaching and mentoring other communication personnel.
* Provide or facilitate communications training as needed.
* Provide training to BMS personnel and introduce new, cost\-effective digital technologies for the more rapid collection and dissemination of multimedia materials.
* Ensure quality control over BMS publications, including compliance with UNDP Communication toolkit and corporate branding toolkits;
* Continuously review work produced by Communication personnel and ensure it is of the highest standards of UNDP.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.


**Institutional Arrangement**

The Media Communication Specialist will work under day\-to\-day guidance and supervision of the Chief, Client Services Division. The incumbent will be responsible for the fulfilment of the duties and responsibilities as specified above.


**COMPETENCIES**

* **Achieve Results** : LEVEL 3: Set and align challenging, achievable objectives for multiple projects, have lasting impact
* **Think Innovatively** : LEVEL 3: Proactively mitigate potential risks, develop new ideas to solve complex problems
* **Learn Continuously** : LEVEL 3: Create and act on opportunities to expand horizons, diversify experiences
* **Adapt with Agility** : LEVEL 3: Proactively initiate and champion change, manage multiple competing demands
* **Act with Determination** : LEVEL 3: Think beyond immediate task/barriers and take action to achieve greater results
* **Engage and Partner** : LEVEL 3: Political savvy, navigate complex landscape, champion inter\-agency collaboration
* **Enable Diversity and Inclusion** : LEVEL 3: Appreciate benefits of diverse workforce and champion inclusivity

***People Management***

UNDP People Management Competencies can be found in the dedicated site .


**CROSS\-FUNCTIONAL \& TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES**

**Business Management**

* **Working with Evidence and Data :** Ability to inspect, cleanse, transform and model data with the goal of discovering useful information, informing conclusions and supporting decision\-making
* **Digital Awareness and Literacy:** Ability to monitor new and emerging technologies, as well as understand their usage, potential, limitations, impact, and added value. Ability to rapidly and readily adopt and use new technologies in professional activities, and to empower others to use them as needed. Knowledge of the usage of digital technologies and emerging trends
* **Customer Satisfaction/Client Management:** Ability to respond timely and appropriately with a sense of urgency, provide consistent solutions, and deliver timely and quality results and/or solutions to fulfil and understand the real customers' needs. Provide inputs to the development of customer service strategy. Look for ways to add value beyond clients' immediate requests. Ability to anticipate client's upcoming needs and concerns
* **Communication:** Communicate in a clear, concise and unambiguous manner both through written and verbal communication; to tailor messages and choose communication methods depending on the audience. Ability to manage communications internally and externally, through media, social media and other appropriate channels

**Business Direction \& Strategy**

* **System Thinking:** Ability to use objective problem analysis and judgement to understand how interrelated elements coexist within an overall process or system, and to consider how altering one element can impact on other parts of the system

**Communications**

* **Product management:** Ability to manage digital products through their entire life cycle.
* **Writing and editing:** Ability to create and/or edit written content in different UN languages.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education:**

* Advanced university degree (Master’s degree or equivalent) in Communications, Journalism, Information Management, Digital Social Media, Public Relations, Graphic Design or a related discipline is required OR
* A first\-level university degree (Bachelor’s degree) in one of these fields in combination with two additional years of qualifying experience will be given due consideration in lieu of Master´s degree.
* Professional certifications related to web and content management, digital collaboration, data/content/process visualization software/tools, desirable.

**Experience, Knowledge, and Skills:**

* Minimum 7 years (with Master’s degree) or 9 years (with a Bachelor’s degree) of progressive working experience in social media management at the national or international level is required.
* Experience using web and online management systems is required.
* Experience using Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, MS Teams, OneDrive, Co\-pilot) and Adobe Acrobat is required
* Photo editing and graphic/multimedia design experience is required.
* Experience with UN/UNDP corporate policies/procedures.
* Previous experience working in a multilateral or international organization with a multi\-cultural environment and multiple stakeholders.
* Experience in media engagement, digital communication and social media.
* Prior experience and knowledge on development cooperation and the United Nations/multilateral organizations.
* Demonstrated experience forging partnerships with the creative sector, including for international advocacy events and initiatives.

**Language Requirements:**

* Fluency in English is required
* Working knowledge of another UN language is desirable.

**Equal opportunity**

As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization. Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.


UNDP is also committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, are valued, can thrive, and benefit from career opportunities that are open to all.


**Sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse of authority**

UNDP does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles.


**Right to select multiple candidates**

UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.


**Use of AI by candidates**

Applicants are invited to read UNDP’s guidance for candidates on using AI responsibly in UNDP recruitment and selection


**Scam alert**

UNDP does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process. For further information, please see www.undp.org/scam\-alert.

 , with an ability to understand the nuances of different Muslim communities and translate global ideas into locally relevant marketing.

* Create, manage and maintain the social media content calendar.

* Continuously test new formats, platforms and approaches to grow Muzz's organic presence.

**Campaigner, Germany** 




 📍 Location: Remote,
 **Germany** 
 .
 



 ⏳
 
 Work Type: Full\-time, flexible hours
 



  





 Are you an inspiring storyteller who wants to use your skills to defend life, family, and freedom?
 



  





 CitizenGO is seeking a Campaigner to craft compelling campaigns and powerful messages that inspire people to take action. This is your chance to use your writing and campaigning talents to create real\-world impact, shape national conversations, and advance the values we hold dear.
 



  





 You’ll be a catalyst for action, inspiring thousands to sign petitions, participate in campaigns, and engage in the defense of fundamental freedoms. If you want your work to drive real change every day, we want to hear from you!
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As Campaigner for Germany, you will be at the heart of CitizenGO’s advocacy work, developing and running national campaigns that turn important political and cultural moments into opportunities for action.
 



  





 You will monitor political, legislative, and cultural developments, identify strong campaign opportunities, and craft persuasive emails, petitions, and calls to action that mobilize supporters. You will take ownership of your campaigns from research and development through launch and follow\-up.
 



  





 You will also prepare, adapt, or translate global campaign communications from English, ensuring they are clear, compelling, and culturally relevant for your audience.
 



  





 Beyond digital campaigning, you will contribute to offline actions such as petition deliveries, public campaign actions, and other campaign activities. You may also engage with journalists, activists, influencers, and like\-minded organizations to expand the reach and impact of your campaigns.
 



  





 Working closely with the Campaign Director and the wider CitizenGO team, you will help ensure that our supporters’ signatures, participation, and donations translate into meaningful impact.
 



  





 This role reports to the Manager of Global Campaigns and offers a flexible schedule, provided all responsibilities are fulfilled on time and with excellence.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* You will monitor global and national developments to identify opportunities for impactful campaigns.
* You will draft, proofread, edit, and send compelling petitions and campaign emails to CitizenGO supporters.
* You will create and refine prompts for AI tools to enhance emails, communications, and other written materials.
* You will research and source relevant, issue\-specific supporting materials from the press, NGOs, etc., for campaigns.
* You will coordinate local briefings, press releases, and campaign research in German.
* You will send emails to CitizenGO’s supporters in your list to inform them about new campaigns and ongoing campaign results.
* You will translate and adapt CitizenGO’s global campaigns and emails from English into German, ensuring they are clear and culturally relevant.
* You will manage communication with supporters and respond to inquiries when needed.
* You will propose offline actions such as ad buys and public petition deliveries.
* You will attend, lead, and/or support campaign events and take ownership of local logistics when necessary.
* You will assist and advise the Media Campaigners on offline events and performances related to campaigns.
* You will engage in public speaking and media relations.
* You will establish connections with journalists, influencers, and activists on social media to expand campaign reach.
* You will manage correspondence and conduct consultations (e.g., polling) with members.



  





**Who you are** 



* You are strongly aligned with CitizenGO’s mission and are motivated to advance it through your work.
* You are based in Germany, and can write and communicate in German at a native\-level standard.
* You are available to travel for offline activities (on\-site events) once a month.
* You have at least a B2\-level proficiency in English. (Duolingo English Test required for non\-natives, minimum score of 100\). Spanish and other languages are a plus.
* You demonstrate good strategic, creative, and innovative thinking, with the ability to analyze socio\-political scenarios, develop complex ideas, and communicate them clearly.
* You understand how civic advocacy, citizen mobilization, and grassroots campaigning function.
* You demonstrate high professionalism, self\-motivation, efficiency, and results\-oriented delivery on short timelines.
* You have strong teamwork skills and are comfortable in a highly collaborative team culture and a hierarchical team structure.
* You can adjust quickly to changing conditions and requirements.
* You are willing to work autonomously on a variety of tasks and projects, prioritizing them efficiently.
* You are proactive, take the initiative to get the job done, and contribute valuable projects and proposals to the entire organization.
* You have strong user\-level computer skills. Experience with Google Workspace is preferred, and proficiency in CRM software and project management tools is an asset.
* You have a flexible schedule, can work on tight deadlines, and are available for evening and weekend work and occasional travel as the need arises.
* You have previous experience in copywriting and producing marketing content, which is an asset.
* You are proficient in using AI tools and agents to generate and improve emails, communications, and other written materials.
* You are familiar with managing social media accounts, which is a plus.



  





**Benefits** 



* **Work from anywhere** 
 – Enjoy the flexibility of remote work.
* **Flexible hours** 
 – Manage your own schedule.
* **24 vacation days** 
 per year plus local public holidays.
* **Tuition reimbursement** 
 – Up to €500 per year for professional development.
* **Language courses** 
 – Monthly allowance for English or Spanish iTalki lessons ($120 monthly).
* **One free book per month** 
 – Up to €30 each.
* **Home office setup allowance** 
 – €500 every two years to optimize your workspace.
* **Coworking membership support** 
 – Up to €200 per month.
* **Access to cutting\-edge AI tools** 
 – Access advanced Artificial Intelligence resources to support your day\-to\-day work.
* **Annual retreats and networking events** 
 – Team meetups, retreats, and networking events throughout the year.



  





**How to Apply** 




 Fill out the application, and include your resume. Successful candidates will proceed through the following steps:
 


1. First interview with PeopleOps.
2. Second interview with the Manager of Global Campaigns.
3. Paid campaign drafting task to assess copywriting skills.
4. Third interview with the Director of Global Campaigns.
5. Duolingo English Test
6. Offer extended to the final candidate.



  





**Recruitment Process Timeline** 




 The hiring process typically takes
 **2 to 8 weeks from first interview to final decision** 
 . Timelines may vary depending on holidays, the number of candidates, and the role's level and complexity.
 



  





**Start Making an Impact Today! Apply Now!**

Eaton is an intelligent power management company dedicated to improving the quality of life and protecting the environment for people everywhere. We are guided by our commitment to do business right, to operate sustainably and to help our customers manage power today and well into the future. By capitalizing on the global growth trends of electrification and digitalization, we’re accelerating the planet’s transition to renewable energy and helping to solve the world’s most urgent power management challenges. Eaton was founded in 1911 and has more than 92000 employees around the globe. In 2025, we generated almost $28 billion in sales and we served customers in more than 160 countries.  



**We make what matters work.**

Are you a marketer who thrives at the intersection of strategy, sales enablement and partner engagement? Join Eaton's EMEA EWS Channel Marketing community and take ownership of how we grow with our Electrical Wholesalers in Germany — one of our most important routes to market.  



**Channel Marketing Manager, Electrical Wholesalers (EWS) \- (m/w/d)**
----------------------------------------------------------------------

Hybrid position (3/2\) based in Bonn, NRW, Germany  



You will develop and execute the channel marketing strategy for a defined pool of EWS partners in Germany, aligned with the local business strategy and the EMEA EWS Partner Programme. Scope may extend cross\-country depending on business needs. You will work closely with EWS Channel Sales, Field Product Marketing, Product Marcom and Demand Generation.  



**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

* Own the local execution of the EWS Partner Programme within the EMEA framework.
* Build and deliver the annual channel marketing plan and MDF (Marketing Development Fund) budget, ensuring efficient allocation, follow\-up and ROI (Return on Investment).
* Shape a contact data strategy enabling segmentation and richer Salesforce\-based engagement.
* Drive New Product Launches through the EWS channel — POS (Point of Sale) materials, videos, merchandising, partner documentation.
* Localise marketing enablement and promotional materials, including digital content.
* Join key partner QBRs (Quarterly Business Reviews) with EWS Key Account Managers and support field sales through regular visits to partner locations.
* Plan and execute partner events, webinars and trainings to boost engagement and lead generation.
* Align Tier 1 push/pull campaigns with Tier 2 activities from Demand Marketing to maximise partner sell\-out.
* Monitor and report on To\- and Through\-Channel effectiveness with data\-driven recommendations.
* Champion the digital transformation of EWS partners \- configurators, partner portal, Partner Relationship Management, e\-commerce, Application Programming Interfaces (APIs).
Track partner satisfaction and collect market and competitor insights to identify new growth opportunities.  
* 
**Qualifications and skills:**
------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communication, Business or Technical discipline.
* Experience in marketing communications, ideally within a B2B, channel marketing or partner\-focused environment. Experience in the electrical industry or wholesale channel is an advantage but not a prerequisite
* We welcome applications from both experienced professionals and high\-potential early\-career candidates who bring a strong academic background, a digital mindset and the ambition to grow within an international marketing organization.
* Interest in channel business models, distribution networks and go\-to\-market strategies, with the curiosity and willingness to continuously learn and develop expertise in these areas.
* Project management, communication and presentation skills, combined with a collaborative and customer\-focused approach.
* A hands\-on attitude and the initiative to turn ideas into action in an international, matrixed environment.
* Willingness to travel approximately 25–30% of the time for customer visits, trade fairs and other business\-related activities.
Fluent German and English language skills are essential for this role.  
* 
**What we offer:**
------------------

* Be part of a global organization where you can learn, grow and build a meaningful career.
* Contribute to innovative solutions that help customers address the world's energy challenges.
* Experience a collaborative, inclusive and values\-led culture where every voice matters.
Benefit from flexible and hybrid working arrangements alongside a competitive compensation and benefits package such as 33 days of annual leave and a company car for private use.  
* 
At EATON we are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for job applicants and employees. BRAND MANAGER (F/M/X)
  

The International Paralympic Committee (IPC) offers the position of a full\-time
  

Brand Manager (f/m/x) in an international and multicultural team at the IPC
  

Headquarters (on\-site) in Bonn, Germany, starting as soon as possible.


ABOUT THE IPC
  

At the IPC, we work as one team, aligned and focused on fulfilling our vision and
  

mission.


The IPC’s vision is for an inclusive world through Para sport. We believe that
  

Change Starts With Sport, and that the work of the Paralympic Movement is a
  

catalyst for driving social inclusion and advancing the UN Convention on the
  

Rights of Persons with Disabilities and the UN’s 17 Sustainable Development Goals.


The IPC, a purpose\-driven non\-profit association, is the global governing body of
  

the Paralympic Movement. We oversee the delivery of the Paralympic Games and
  

Paralympic Winter Games and serve as International Federation for five Para
  

sports. We enjoy a positive working relationship with the IPC Governing Board,
  

members of which are democratically elected every four years by the IPC General
  

Assembly. Since 1989, we have been creating change through sport with the
  

Paralympic Games and Paralympic athletes at our core.


The IPC seeks to use the influential global position of the Paralympic Movement
  

and the growing profile of Para athletes to challenge the stigma attached to
  

disability and empower social transformation.


ROLE
  

The IPC Brand Team is part of the Brand \& Communications department. We take
  

care of the brand and identity of the IPC and how it is viewed and perceived in its
  

pursuit to impact positively in the world. We strive in the mission of finding new
  

ways to promote the values of the Paralympic Movement.


The Brand Manager (f/m/x) is placed at Level A6 according to our internal
  

compensation structure. The role is accountable to the Brand Senior Manager and





will be responsible for coordinating and managing the IPC and Paralympic Games’
  

brand projects and developing and implementing them internally and externally.


CORE RESPONSIBILITIES


* Manage all IPC brand and design functions and assets.
* Coordinate and manage the signoff of the brand assets (both internal and

external) to ensure compliance with the IPC Brand Guidelines.
  

* Maintain proactive interdepartmental communication within the
organisation and with our Members (National Paralympic Committees,
  

International Federations, International Organisations of Sport for the
  

Disabled and Regional Organisations).


* Collaborate with the Paralympic Games Organising Committees to oversee

the successful delivery of the Paralympic Torch Relay, from initial concept
  

to final delivery, including responsibility for IPC Torchbearers and all
  

internal logistics.
* Support the Brand Senior Manager in all Paralympic Games Brand, Image

and Look (BIL), Signage (SIG), Culture (CUL), and Spectator Experience (OFX)
  

matters.
* Administrate the Brand inbox.
* Keep strong awareness of the IPC brand benchmarks across all media.
* Perform other duties as requested.

CORE REQUIREMENTS


* A minimum of 3 years of experience in brand and/or marketing.
* Bachelor’s degree in Brand, Marketing, Design and/or a relevant field.
* Knowledge and experience in managing brands; experience with sport

brands is a plus.
  

* Experience in the use of Adobe applications (such as Photoshop, Illustrator,
inDesign) and Canva; proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office tools.
  

* Has a passion for sports and the Paralympic Movement.
* Proven leadership and management skills, with a strong strategic mindset.
* Proactivity and passion for developing the IPC brand.
* Excellent and effective communication skills, both written and oral, in
English. Additional languages are a plus.





* Strong interpersonal skills enabling effective cross\-department

collaboration within the IPC and fostering clear communication with IPC
  

members on brand\-related matters.
* Ability to work comfortably in a fast\-paced, multicultural, multi\-tasking

environment, with the capacity to operate independently and with limited
  

supervision.
* Excellent attention to detail, strategic thinking, creativity, curiosity, strong

organisational skills, and a proven ability to meet deadlines.
* Flexibility to work outside standard working hours depending on the time

zone requirements for the delivery of projects, and willingness to undertake
  

occasional travel during Games time.
DESIRED REQUIREMENTS


* Experience working in sport events will be an advantage.
* Experience with digital content tools is a plus.
* Knowledge of the IPC Brand is a plus.

Do you want to apply?
  

  

If you are interested and provide a good match with our requirements, please send
  

your CV and cover letter in English and in PDF to
  

CommunicationJobs@paralympic.org
  

  

For this position, we will review applications and interview candidates on a rolling
  

basis.
  

  

The IPC is an equal opportunity employer, and we especially encourage individuals
  

with a disability and members of minority groups to apply; we support the
  

relocation process and provide transitional accessible accommodation. For
  

further information on the IPC, please contact us or visit our career website at
  

www.paralympic.org/careers.  

  



We look forward to your application!

The Global OT Application Owner owns the strategy, roadmap and backlog of the assigned global OT application. The role governs the assigned solution scope, including its global templates, technical and functional standards, software providers and system integrators, and ensures that the application delivers business value and can be consistently deployed, operated and improved across our client sites.

**Assigned scope:**

* Ignition IIoT platform across the client manufacturing sites.
* Ignition SCADA and MES across the client manufacturing sites.

**Primary emphasis:**

* Architecture and global standards; global library governance.

**Main tasks / Standard of performance**

**Application Strategy and Roadmap:**

* Define and maintain the application strategy and multi\-year roadmap.
* Translate business and plant requirements into clear application priorities.
* Decide what should be developed, configured, purchased, scaled, deferred or retired.
* Govern the application throughout its complete lifecycle.

**Backlog and Requirements:**

* Own, structure and prioritize the application backlog.
* Establish clear requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure that delivered functionality meets the agreed requirements, coordinating formal acceptance with the relevant business and site stakeholders.

**Global Templates and Standards:**

* Define and maintain global templates, libraries and application standards.
* Approve template changes, releases and deviations from the global standard.
* Govern application quality, compliance, scalability and maintainability.
* Ensure alignment with OT architecture, cybersecurity, data and integration standards.

**Rollout Governance:**

* Govern rollout priorities, standards and application decisions across the application rollout portfolio.
* Negotiate rollout scope, priorities and commitments with site leadership and plant management.
* Coordinate application engineers, developers, vendors and system integrators.

**Vendor and System\-Integrator Steering:**

* Challenge vendors and system integrators at technical, delivery and commercial levels.
* Govern vendor performance, roadmap commitments, service levels, licensing and costs.

**Operations, Adoption and Reporting:**

* Monitor application adoption, operational performance, incidents and support trends.
* Escalate application risks, delivery gaps and vendor\-performance issues.
* Maintain transparent communication with business, plant and technical stakeholders.

**Compliance, Policy and Transparency:**

* Ensure the application complies with the client policies, standards and directives, including the mandatory criteria defined for its control zone.
* Maintain the application profile and keep the inventory of the solutions in scope up to date.
* Ensure transparent reporting of application costs, risks, service information and benefits towards Group OT and the regional Digital OT/IT organization.
* Ensure that the Cloud Service Provider Check is completed and that Security clearance is obtained before any application contract is signed.

**Data, Security and Audit:**

* Be accountable for the data stored and processed in the application, including in the event of cyber incidents such as data breach or unauthorized access.
* Govern application user access management across the user lifecycle where the application is not integrated into the client's global Active Directory.
* Act as the contact person for the application in internal and external audits.

**Application\-Specific Requirements:**

* Governance of the global Ignition library, templates and reusable components.
* Definition of development, integration, versioning and release standards.
* Skills and competencies

**Functional \& Technical Competencies:**

* Application ownership: able to own the strategy, roadmap and backlog of a global industrial application and to decide what is developed, configured, purchased, scaled, deferred or retired.
* Requirements and acceptance: comfortable authoring requirements and acceptance criteria and running formal acceptance with business and site stakeholders.
* OT/IT and manufacturing data environments: working knowledge of SCADA/PLC, MES, IIoT, Unified Namespace and ERP interfaces.
* Standards and lifecycle governance: able to define and govern global templates, libraries and technical/functional standards, including quality, scalability and maintainability.
* Security, data and compliance awareness: familiar with OT cybersecurity, data classification, access management, group policy and audit requirements.
* Vendor and system\-integrator steering: able to challenge providers on technical fit, delivery quality, service levels and cost.
* Platform architecture: strong architectural understanding of industrial SCADA, IIoT and MES platforms.
* Integration and deployment: strong knowledge of SCADA, PLC integration, OPC\-UA, MQTT, APIs and deployment practices.
* Scalability: able to ensure consistency and scalability of the solution across the global site landscape, and to challenge architects, developers, vendors and system integrators.
* Languages: English as a minimum.

**Behavioral Competencies:**

* Analytical and decisive: structures ambiguous plant demand into clear decisions on scope and priority.
* Influence without authority: negotiates priorities and commitments between plant demand and constrained delivery capacity.
* Universal communication: fluid between shop\-floor, business and technical language.
* Organized and disciplined: able to run a multi\-site, multi\-rollout portfolio with competing priorities, risks and dependencies.
* Pragmatic and outcome\-oriented: balances global standards with day\-to\-day operational reality on the shop floor.
* Organizational network and visibility: well\-connected across business, OT and IT, able to mobilize the right people quickly.

**Experience**

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Technical degree in automation, industrial or process engineering, computer science or a related field.
* Hands\-on experience in a manufacturing/production environment with OT systems (SCADA/PLC/MES/IIoT) and exposure to IT/data environments.
* Experience owning or functionally leading an industrial application: backlog, requirements, acceptance and lifecycle.
* Experience steering vendors and system integrators.
* Experience with multi\-site deployments across plants and regions.
* Languages: English as a minimum.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Ignition certification (Inductive University) or equivalent demonstrated platform expertise.
* Experience governing global libraries, templates, versioning and release standards on an industrial platform.

**Responsibility / Power of authority**

**The Application Owner:**

* Sets and signs off on the application strategy and multi\-year roadmap.
* Decides backlog content and priority order.
* Approves global templates, libraries and application standards.
* Approves or rejects application changes, releases and deviations from the global standard.
* Decides rollout sequencing and application priorities across sites.
* Escalates vendor and system\-integrator performance and decides when to challenge it formally.
* Recommends lifecycle decisions, including scale\-up and retirement of the application.
* Confirms compliance of the application with group policies, standards and mandatory criteria.
* Answers for the data stored and processed in the application, including in the event of cyber incidents.
* Represents the application in audits and holds Security clearance before any contract signature.
* Authority is limited to application direction, priorities, standards and acceptance. The role does not manage the daily technical work of engineers and developers or replace the project managers responsible for rollout planning and execution.

**Team work / Team membership**

**Communicates to:**

* Lead OT: management connection, portfolio steering and long\-term planning.
* Regional Digital OT/IT Leads: regional rollout planning, priorities and dependencies.
* Plant Leads and plant management: rollout scope, localization, commitments and adoption.
* Application engineers, developers and architects: functional steering of design, development and release work.
* Vendors and system integrators: technical, delivery and commercial steering; roadmap and service levels.
* OT Architecture, Cybersecurity and Data roles: alignment with architecture, security, data and integration standards.
* Project managers: rollout planning and execution; sequencing, dependencies and escalation of deviations.

At AG Solution, we build intelligent solutions for the process industry, combining automation, process control, data management, and MES/MOM systems to help manufacturers reach operational excellence.

The Global OT Application Owner owns the strategy, roadmap and backlog of the assigned global OT application. The role governs the assigned solution scope, including its global templates, technical and functional standards, software providers and system integrators, and ensures that the application delivers business value and can be consistently deployed, operated and improved across our client sites.

**Assigned scope:**

* Syntact\-delivered application portfolio: KPI for IIoT, Galileo for MES and Supervision for SCADA.

**Primary emphasis:**

* Rollouts and vendor steering; multiproject and commercial leadership.

**Main tasks / Standard of performance**

**Application Strategy and Roadmap:**

* Define and maintain the application strategy and multi\-year roadmap.
* Translate business and plant requirements into clear application priorities.
* Decide what should be developed, configured, purchased, scaled, deferred or retired.
* Govern the application throughout its complete lifecycle.

**Backlog and Requirements:**

* Own, structure and prioritize the application backlog.
* Establish clear requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure that delivered functionality meets the agreed requirements, coordinating formal acceptance with the relevant business and site stakeholders.

**Global Templates and Standards:**

* Define and maintain global templates, libraries and application standards.
* Approve template changes, releases and deviations from the global standard.
* Govern application quality, compliance, scalability and maintainability.
* Ensure alignment with OT architecture, cybersecurity, data and integration standards.

**Rollout Governance:**

* Govern rollout priorities, standards and application decisions across the application rollout portfolio.
* Negotiate rollout scope, priorities and commitments with site leadership and plant management.
* Coordinate application engineers, developers, vendors and system integrators.

**Vendor and System\-Integrator Steering:**

* Challenge vendors and system integrators at technical, delivery and commercial levels.
* Govern vendor performance, roadmap commitments, service levels, licensing and costs.

**Operations, Adoption and Reporting:**

* Monitor application adoption, operational performance, incidents and support trends.
* Escalate application risks, delivery gaps and vendor\-performance issues.
* Maintain transparent communication with business, plant and technical stakeholders.

**Compliance, Policy and Transparency:**

* Ensure the application complies with the client policies, standards and directives, including the mandatory criteria defined for its control zone.
* Enforce client's Unified Namespace requirements on the Syntact\-delivered scope, including naming, structure and data\-contract standards.
* Maintain the application profile and keep the inventory of the solutions in scope up to date.
* Ensure transparent reporting of application costs, risks, service information and benefits towards Group OT and the regional Digital OT/IT organization.
* Ensure that the Cloud Service Provider Check is completed and that Security clearance is obtained before any application contract is signed.

**Data, Security and Audit:**

* Be accountable for the data stored and processed in the application, including in the event of cyber incidents such as data breach or unauthorized access.
* Govern application user access management across the user lifecycle where the application is not integrated into our client's global Active Directory.
* Act as the contact person for the application in internal and external audits.

**Application\-Specific Requirements:**

* Governance of rollout scope, localization, priorities and dependencies.
* Coordination of the current Syntact\-delivered scope across KPI for IIoT, Galileo for MES and Supervision for SCADA.

**Skills and competencies**

**Functional \& Technical Competencies:**

* Application ownership: able to own the strategy, roadmap and backlog of a global industrial application and to decide what is developed, configured, purchased, scaled, deferred or retired.
* Requirements and acceptance: comfortable authoring requirements and acceptance criteria and running formal acceptance with business and site stakeholders.
* OT/IT and manufacturing data environments: working knowledge of SCADA/PLC, MES, IIoT, Unified Namespace and ERP interfaces.
* Standards and lifecycle governance: able to define and govern global templates, libraries and technical/functional standards, including quality, scalability and maintainability.
* Security, data and compliance awareness: familiar with OT cybersecurity, data classification, access management, group policy and audit requirements.
* Vendor and system\-integrator steering: able to challenge providers on technical fit, delivery quality, service levels and cost.
* Project and multiproject management: strong capabilities in planning, sequencing and controlling parallel rollouts.
* Commercial steering: able to challenge delivery estimates, commitments and commercial assumptions, and to negotiate with site leadership and plant management.
* Technical judgement: sufficient technical understanding to challenge proposed solutions across KPI for IIoT, Galileo for MES and Supervision for SCADA.
* Languages: English as a minimum; French an advantage.

**Behavioral Competencies:**

* Analytical and decisive: structures ambiguous plant demand into clear decisions on scope and priority.
* Influence without authority: negotiates priorities and commitments between plant demand and constrained delivery capacity.
* Universal communication: fluid between shop\-floor, business and technical language.
* Organized and disciplined: able to run a multi\-site, multi\-rollout portfolio with competing priorities, risks and dependencies.
* Pragmatic and outcome\-oriented: balances global standards with day\-to\-day operational reality on the shop floor.
* Organizational network and visibility: well\-connected across business, OT and IT, able to mobilize the right people quickly.

**Experience**

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Technical degree in automation, industrial or process engineering, computer science or a related field.
* Hands\-on experience in a manufacturing/production environment with OT systems (SCADA/PLC/MES/IIoT) and exposure to IT/data environments.
* Experience owning or functionally leading an industrial application: backlog, requirements, acceptance and lifecycle.
* Experience steering vendors and system integrators.
* Experience with multi\-site deployments across plants and regions.
* Languages: English as a minimum; French an advantage.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in multiproject management and in commercial and contract negotiation with software providers and system integrators.
* French language skills, given the vendor and site landscape in scope.

**Responsibility / Power of authority**

**The Application Owner:**

* Sets and signs off on the application strategy and multi\-year roadmap.
* Decides backlog content and priority order.
* Approves global templates, libraries and application standards.
* Approves or rejects application changes, releases and deviations from the global standard.
* Decides rollout sequencing and application priorities across sites.
* Escalates vendor and system\-integrator performance and decides when to challenge it formally.
* Recommends lifecycle decisions, including scale\-up and retirement of the application.
* Confirms compliance of the application with group policies, standards and mandatory criteria.
* Answers for the data stored and processed in the application, including in the event of cyber incidents.
* Represents the application in audits and holds Security clearance before any contract signature.
* Authority is limited to application direction, priorities, standards and acceptance. The role does not manage the daily technical work of engineers and developers or replace the project managers responsible for rollout planning and execution.

The **Global OT Application Developer** builds, maintains, tests and stabilises application components and use cases for industrial environments. The role converts approved requirements, designs and standards into reliable software, scripts, connectors, interfaces and dashboards that can be reused across applications and sites.


The Application Developer works closely with Application Engineers throughout implementation, integration, testing and stabilisation, must understand the operational and technical context in which the solution will run, and remains involved in resolving defects and technical issues. It is not an isolated coding position.

**Assigned scope:**

* Configuration and development of use cases within Global OT applications.
* Development and maintenance of standard interfaces between Global OT applications.
* Implementation of improvements to ensure correct performance of Global OT applications and interfaces.
* Writing and maintaining technical documentation, release notes and other documentation required for proper software governance.

**Primary emphasis:**

* Features that are stable, maintainable and suitable for reuse across applications or sites.
* Code and configurations for use cases and interfaces that follow agreed versioning and delivery practices.
* Documented components that Application Engineers can integrate, deploy and support.

**Main tasks / Standard of performance**

**Build and maintain application components:**

* Development and implementation of logic within the application components required to deliver approved application functionality and use cases.
* Implement application features, scripts, connectors, interfaces and dashboards.
* Build and maintain within application domains such as IIoT, MES, SCADA, historians and maintenance systems.
* Develop database structures and application interfaces in accordance with the approved design and relevant application practices.
* Maintain existing applications and application components and adapt them when approved requirements or standards change.

**Test and stabilise:**

* Take responsibility for the technical quality of the developments and configurations.
* Create and execute developer\-level tests and support broader functional and integration testing.
* Identify, diagnose and correct defects discovered during implementation, testing and stabilisation.
* Verify that the code deliverables meet the defined requirements and behave reliably in the target application environment.
* Support Application Engineers during integration and deployment when code, configuration or component\-level troubleshooting is required.

**Reuse, standards and maintainability:**

* Ensure that development can be governed, maintained and reused beyond a single isolated requirement.
* Use reusable logics, UX/UI and features where appropriate.
* Follow agreed coding, configuration, naming and documentation standards,
* Consider performance, reliability and maintainability when implementing application requirements.
* Document code, configurations, dependencies and technical behaviour clearly enough for integration and support.

**Controlled delivery and versioning:**

* Develop within the agreed versioning, review and release process.
* Use Git or the agreed source\-control platform for versioning and collaboration.
* Follow the applicable CI/CD, code\-review, testing and release practices
* Maintain traceability between approved requirements, implemented changes and delivered versions.
* Contribute to the correction and stabilisation of released components when development changes are required.

**Collaboration across the application lifecycle:**

* Work with the Application Owner on approved scope, priorities, standards and acceptance expectations.
* Work with Application Engineers on technical integration, testing, deployment and support needs.
* Clarify functional and technical requirements with the relevant business, engineering and architecture contributors.
* Provide transparent estimates, technical risks, dependencies and delivery status to the relevant delivery lead or Scrum Master.
* Participate in defect resolution and technical discussions with vendors or system integrators when the developed components are involved.

**Application\-specific requirements:**

* SQL and application database development.
* Programming or scripting using Python, C\#, Java or comparable technologies.
* Industrial integration using MQTT, OPC UA and REST APIs.
* Git\-based versioning and collaborative development practices.
* Implementation, testing, defect correction and feature stabilisation.
* CI/CD, code review and controlled release practices.
* Creation and maintenance of technical documentation covering code, configurations, interfaces and delivered components.
* Contribution across IIoT applications and use cases (including platforms such as Ignition), MES applications, historian and industrial\-data applications, and maintenance applications, depending on the assigned application background.

**Skills and competencies**

**Functional \& Technical Competencies:**

* Advanced: SQL and application database development, including database structures and application interfaces.
* Advanced: programming or scripting using Python, C\#, Java or comparable technologies.
* Proficient: industrial integration using MQTT, OPC UA and REST APIs.
* Git\-based versioning, CI/CD, code review and controlled release practices.
* Working knowledge of secure software development lifecycle requirements under IEC 62443\-4\-1\.
* Working knowledge of application domains such as IIoT (including platforms such as Ignition), MES, historians and maintenance systems.

**Behavioral Competencies:**

* Structured, pragmatic and quality\-oriented, with strong ownership of the technical quality of own deliverables.
* Constructive challenge of requirements, designs and technical solutions where quality or maintainability is at risk.
* Clear cross\-functional communication of estimates, risks, dependencies and delivery status across engineering, business and external audiences.

**Experience**

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in software, computer science, automation, electrical or industrial engineering, or comparable practical experience.
* Experience developing and maintaining software components for industrial or manufacturing applications such as IIoT, MES, historians or maintenance systems; senior appointments normally require demonstrated ownership of complex application components across multiple applications or sites.
* Professional English; additional languages relevant to the assigned region are an advantage.

**Working Conditions and Location:**

* Primary European hiring locations Barcelona and southern or western Germany.
* Home\-based or hybrid working, including collaboration with nearshore and distributed delivery teams.
* Occasional travel to manufacturing sites where development support is required.

**Responsibility / Power of authority**

**The Global OT Application Developer is accountable for:**

* Choosing detailed implementation approaches within approved requirements, architecture and standards.
* Identifying technical risks and proposing improvements to components and delivery practices.
* Raising concerns about potential future issues — technical debt, scalability, maintainability or obsolescence — to the Application Owner and architecture contributors before they affect operations.
* Rejecting code or components that do not meet agreed quality and versioning practices.
* Supporting integration, deployment and troubleshooting when development expertise is required.
* The role does not own the application roadmap, backlog priorities or acceptance decisions, plant connectivity, site readiness, commissioning or operational support, and does not define platform architecture or approve material deviations from global standards; nor does it operate as an isolated programmer without testing, stabilisation and engineering collaboration.

**Team work / Team membership**

**Communicates to:**

* Application Owner: approved scope, priorities, standards and acceptance expectations.
* Application Engineers: technical integration, testing, deployment and support needs; day\-to\-day collaboration throughout implementation and stabilisation.
* Delivery lead / Scrum Master: estimates, technical risks, dependencies and delivery status.
* Business, engineering and architecture contributors: clarification of functional and technical requirements.
* Vendors and system integrators: defect resolution and technical discussions where the developed components are involved.
* Nearshore / distributed delivery teams: shared requirements, standards, testing, versioning and documentation practices; dotted\-line collaboration with Application Engineers regardless of location.

**About WPP Media**



WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Wir bei T\&P verstehen uns als datengetriebene Kommunikationsagentur, deren Mission es ist, Kreativität, Technologie und Daten auf neue, aufregende und effektive Weise zu verknüpfen. Wir nennen es das \&Modell und die Prämisse ist einfach: Kreation, Strategie, Media und Daten/CRM arbeiten Hand in Hand und lösen Herausforderungen als ein Team, das nah und partnerschaftlich mit dem Kunden zusammenarbeitet.

  


**Das bieten wir dir:**
-----------------------


* **Work\-Life\-Balance**: Mit unseren flexiblen Arbeitszeiten \& Remote Work gestaltest du deinen Alltag so, wie er zu dir passt. Außerdem kannst du Überstunden ausgleichen
* **Vacation mode on**: Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24\. und 31\.12\. frei
* **Wellbeing first:** Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt
* **Practice makes perfect**: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP\-Netzwerk
* **More than just a job**: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike
* **Be yourself**: Ableitung von gestalterischen und inhaltlichen Optimierungsempfehlungen auf Basis von Performance\-Zahlen

  


**Das bewegst du:**
-------------------



Als **Content Creator (Mensch)** bist Du der kreative und operative Motor unserer Content\-Produktionen. Du begleitest und steuerst Projekte eigenverantwortlich über den gesamten Lebenszyklus, von der ersten Idee über das energiegeladene Abdrehen vor Ort bis hin zum finalen Schnitt.


* **Ideation \& Konzeption:** Gemeinsame Entwicklung von kreativen Content\-Konzepten für alle relevanten Plattformen (Fokus: TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn) im starken Dreiergespann mit einem Konzeptor aus der klassischen Kreation sowie dem zuständigen Social Media Manager
* **Hands\-on Produktion \& Dreh:** Du schnappst Dir eigeninitiativ die Kamera und setzt die Themen voller Energie vor Ort um, ob Smartphone, DSLM, passendes Licht oder Ton. Du stehst mit Hands\-on Mentalität hinter der Kamera (und packst bei Bedarf auch selbst mit an)
* **Produktionsvorbereitung:** Planung und inhaltliche Vorbereitung von Shootings und Videodrehs (Location, Equipment, Ablaufpläne), in enger Abstimmung und mit organisatorischer Unterstützung durch unser Content\-Office
* **Post\-Production:** Eigenständiges Editing, Color Grading, Sound Design und Einbinden von Grafiken/Effekten für die finalen Assets
* **Trend\-Scouting \& Performance:** Blitzschnelles Aufspüren aktueller Trends, Sounds \& Hypes sowie Ableitung gestalterischer Optimierungen aus Performance\-Daten

  


**Das zeichnet dich aus:**
--------------------------


* **Plattform\-Native:** Tiefes Verständnis für die Algorithmen und Sehgewohnheiten auf Meta, TikTok und YouTube. Du weißt exakt, was funktioniert und was nicht
* **Dreh\- \& Kamera\-Erfahrung:** Erfahrung im eigenständigen Abdrehen von Videos und Content. Du hast den Blick für Bildkomposition, Ton \& Licht sowie die Energie, am Set dynamisch anzupacken
* **Post\-Production\-Skills:** Sichere Beherrschung gängiger Editing\-Software (z. B. Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Photoshop/Figma)
* **Selbstständigkeit:** Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise mit dem Drive, Projekte von der Kameraeinstellung bis zum fertigen Export komplett selbstständig zu führen
* **KI\-Affinität:** Aktive Nutzung und Neugier gegenüber KI\-Tools im kreativen Workflow (z. B. Midjourney, Firefly, ChatGPT, AI\-Editing\-Features)
* **Strukturierte Arbeitsweise:** Auch wenn es am Set oder im Schnitt mal trubelig wird, behältst Du den Überblick über Deine Tasks und Dein Datenmaterial


Darüber hinaus bist du: **\#teamplayer \#innovativ \#wissbegierig**



Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.

  


**Arbeiten bei WPP Media:**
---------------------------



Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. * Nach Einarbeitungsphase eigenständige Wartungs\-, Inspektion\- \& Instandhaltungsarbeiten an elektrotechnischen Anlagen (Montageautomaten, Sondermaschinen, Arburg, Demag, Bihler, Bruderer…)

* Teamfähigkeit

* Engagement, Eigeninitiative und Durchsetzungsfähigkeit

 Im Rahmen deiner dreieinhalbjährigen Berufsausbildung lernst du in unserem Werk sowie in der Berufsschule unter anderem
   

  

* wie mechanische, pneumatische, hydraulische und elektrische Maschinen funktionieren

Du optimierst Arbeitsvorgänge und bist verantwortlich für die Qualität der entstehenden Produkte. Nach der Ausbildung hast du die Chance, dich zum Meister:in oder zum Techniker:in weiterzubilden oder ein Studium zu absolvieren.

 Für die Ausbildung zum Verfahrenstechnologen:in Metall, Fachrichtung Stahlumformung bringst du Folgendes mit:
   

  

* Schulabschluss
* Interesse an der Stahlbearbeitung und die Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen
* Spaß an fachübergreifendem und analytischem Arbeiten
* Lust darauf, als Teil eines Teams dein Bestes zu geben
* Bereitschaft, Neues zu entdecken und offen auf andere zuzugehen


 Das bieten wir
   

  

 Wir bieten moderne Ausbildungsmöglichkeiten, die dich fit für deine Zukunft machen und dir eine gute Basis für deine berufliche Entwicklung geben. Die Ausbildung bei der thyssenkrupp Steel Europe AG beinhaltet einen theoretischen Teil, den du in der Berufsschule absolvierst, sowie einen praktischen Teil, den du in unseren Betrieben, Werkstätten und Fachbereichen oder in unserem Bildungszentrum erlernst. Teamarbeit, geregelte Arbeitszeiten und eine attraktive Ausbildungsvergütung sowie zahlreiche weitere Benefits runden deine Ausbildung bei der thyssenkrupp Steel Europe AG ab.
   

  

 Eine Übersicht aller Vorteile findest du hier.
   

  

 Unternehmen
   

  

 Wir, das sind gut 27\.000 Mitarbeitende an 19 Produktionsstandorten, sind als Deutschlands größter Stahlhersteller nicht nur Ausgangspunkt vieler industrieller Wertschöpfungsketten und Innovationen, sondern auch Wegbereiter der grünen Transformation.
